rulings.model: The worksheet column (c) is 'Qualified tips reported on Form 4137, column 1(c), for this employer', and method 4 says to 'use the amount of qualified tips included for the employer in column 1(c) of Form 4137'. Always entering $0 drops this amount, and no refusal excludes filers who submit Form 4137.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: adopted. Column (c) now carries the refusal of Form 4137 (s2.other); within scope it is zero.
